guard: the rendered console preserves truthful topology identity, membership freshness, activity, and first-send participant failures
why: The suite renders the real Ink components and App from src through tsx, so a mutation is seen without a build; a refused participant start must remain visible without sending or painting success.
MEMBERSHIP_STALE_MS is deliberately NOT mutated: the suite imports that same constant to build its fixtures, so moving it would move both sides of the comparison and prove nothing.
Each mutation is compile-clean and its anchor occurs exactly once in the named file.

mutations.name: R0 bypass the in-flight participant start for a concurrent send
mutations.expectRed: a concurrent send waits instead of bypassing the in-flight participant start
mutations.cell: a concurrent send waits instead of bypassing the in-flight participant start

mutations.name: R1 the freshness comparison is inverted, so live and stale swap
mutations.find: return age < MEMBERSHIP_STALE_MS ? { label: "live", color: "green" } : { label: "stale", color: "yellow" };
mutations.replace: return age > MEMBERSHIP_STALE_MS ? { label: "live", color: "green" } : { label: "stale", color: "yellow" };
mutations.expectRed: live is painted in the header
mutations.cell: live is painted in the header
mutations.note: A fresh membership would paint stale and a stale one live; the operator reads the pill exactly backwards.

mutations.name: R2 an unreadable membership is reported as traffic-only
mutations.find: if (m.unreadable !== undefined) return { label: "unreadable", color: "red", reason: m.unreadable };
mutations.replace: if (false) return { label: "unreadable", color: "red", reason: m.unreadable ?? "" };
mutations.expectRed: unreadable is painted in the header
mutations.cell: unreadable is painted in the header
mutations.note: unreadable is checked first precisely because traffic-only is a claim about the mesh while unreadable is a claim about our own read; collapsing them hides a failure to read as a fact about the mesh.

mutations.name: R3 the refusal wait gates on the clock again, so a late frame reads as no frames captured and the negative cell passes vacuously
mutations.note: Restores the exact defect the Windows runner hit: the poll's deadline governs instead of the frame, so when no frame lands inside it the loop exits on the "" initializer and cell 191 reports an empty paint. The negative cell after it is guarded by the refusal token being present, so it reddens too rather than passing vacuously, which is the second thing this mutation proves.
